Z.AI and Moonshot AI delay next flagship models over training data

Chinese AI companies Z.AI and Moonshot AI have to delay their next flagship models. They are looking for new sources of training data. One Chinese AI developer is turning to Google and Meta after OpenAI and Anthropic shut the door on their data.

Reported by The Decoder. Written by AI.
